meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后,处理 Git 相关请求时,Claude 会先分析仓库语言与提交风格,再按目录、关注点把改动拆成多个原子提交,并处理 rebase/squash 与历史查找(blame、bisect、log -S 等)。
howto.when: 当你说出 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等关键词,或问某段代码谁写的、某功能何时加入等历史问题时触发。

say.text: 把这次改动按模块拆成多个 commit
say.note: 会先检测仓库风格再拆分提交。

say.text: 帮我 rebase 到 main,顺便 squash 成一条
say.note: 会检查分支是否已推送再重写历史。

say.text: 查一下这行是谁在哪个 commit 加进来的
say.note: 会用 blame/log -S 定位引入点。

howto.what_en: After installation, when handling Git requests, Claude first analyzes the repo's language and commit style, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits by directory/concern, and handles rebase/squash plus history search (blame, bisect, log -S).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or ask who wrote a line / when a feature was added / find the commit that introduced something.

say_en.text: Split these changes into multiple commits by module.
say_en.note: It will detect repo style first, then split.

say_en.text: Rebase onto main and squash into a single commit.
say_en.note: Checks branch push state before rewriting history.

say_en.text: Find which commit introduced this line and who wrote it.
say_en.note: Uses blame and log -S to locate the origin.
